{{Top|leg}}
'''Imbue item''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used by the [[Jal Shey]].

Focused on scholarly and scientific pursuits, the Jal Shey were extremely adept at permanently imbuing specially crafted weapons, items, [[Armor/Legends|armors]], and articles of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] - resulting in a wide array of imbued effects that ranged from the mental to the physical. Attuning an item took a massive drain on the crafters reserves, however, with the crafter only being able to imbue energy once every twenty four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> More potent than other traditions' respective abilities to craft items, Jal Shey imbued items were capable of being used by even non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitives]].<ref name="Guide" /> It was said that the Jal Shey were not the only people to use this ability. It was actually pretty common and non-sensitive users of the force could gain extraordinary power.
